proposals.evidence: The full sarva entry gives Bashkarik sō/sūo, Lahnda/Pothwari habbā/habbh, Nepali/Bengali sab, Oriya sabo/sabu and Assamese sɔb/xɔb; it explicitly discusses irregular pronominal h/s and b developments. These whole all-forms fit that series, with final agreement/emphatic vowels retained. Multiword totality expressions and the unrelated-looking saf/bekti series are excluded.

proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly derives the metathesized series from laghu and names Nepali halũ/halaũ/huluṅo, Hindi harū/haruā and Gujarati haḷvũ. These whole light adjectives match that l/h or lv series, including nasal and final agreement vowels; initial h loss remains a regional comparison. Forms with k belong to the separate kk extension and are not silently merged here.
